description: This file contains functions to perform firmware upgrade procedures for GL.iNet devices, including extracting UBI images from FIT images and validating firmware images before proceeding with sysupgrade.

methods.name: glinet_do_fit_upgrade
methods.description: Extracts UBI image from a FIT image, verifies the checksum, replaces the firmware image, and proceeds with sysupgrade.

methods.name: glinet_do_upgrade
methods.description: Validates the firmware image type and either performs FIT image handling or defaults to a standard sysupgrade.
